title: Mutual Fund എന്താണ്? 🧺 ഒരു കൂട്ടായ്മ പോലെ | Day 19 #shorts
description:
The Stoic Bull | Stock Market Zero to Hero, Day 19! Mutual fund = പലരുടെ പണം ഒന്നിച്ച്, ഒരു professional fund manager പല shares/bonds-ൽ invest ചെയ്യുന്നു. SEBI regulate ചെയ്യുന്നു. ഓരോ unit-ന്റെ വില = NAV. Expense ratio ശ്രദ്ധിക്കൂ.

Mutual funds explained: pooled money managed by a professional fund manager, regulated by SEBI; unit price is the NAV. Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks, read all scheme related documents carefully.

⚠️ Educational content only. Not investment advice. We are not SEBI-registered advisers.
